name: I-751 Remove Conditions on Residence
summary: Conditional resident (2-year Green Card through marriage) asks USCIS to remove the conditions, jointly with the spouse or alone with a waiver.

coverLetter.re: Form I-751, Petition to Remove Conditions on Residence
coverLetter.request: We respectfully submit the enclosed Form I-751 on behalf of {{givenName}} {{familyName}}, filed on the basis: {{filingBasis}}.
points: The petitioner obtained conditional residence through a marriage entered in good faith.
The enclosed evidence documents the relationship from the date of marriage to the present.
The petition is timely filed with respect to the conditional residence expiration date of {{cprExpiry}}.
